resources.string: Share this phone\'s internet with your computer. No root, and the phone keeps its own internet.

The old ET Phone Home app is still installed on this phone. This app replaces it (Android installs the two side by side, they can\'t share an update). Uninstall the old one so a desktop doesn\'t connect to it by mistake; desktops paired over WiFi or Bluetooth need this app\'s new token.
